system: Warhammer 40,000 Wargear, Armor, and Augmetic Systems Registry
doctrine: In the 41st Millennium, tools of war are sanctified relics of ancient technology. Equipment directly enhances the biological and synthetic capabilities of the bearer.

item_chainsword_mk7.name: Mark VII Teeth-Worn Chainsword
item_chainsword_mk7.description: A roaring motorized blade lined with monomolecular adamantine teeth, capable of chewing through flesh and bone.

item_combat_shotgun.name: Godwyn-De’az Combat Shotgun
item_combat_shotgun.description: Heavy-bore urban enforcer shotgun chambered for solid penetrator slugs.

item_omnissian_power_axe.name: Omnissian Power Axe & Plasma Cutter
item_omnissian_power_axe.description: Sacred halberd wrapped in an energy disruption field, bearing the cog tooth skull of the Mechanicus.

item_lasgun_kantrael.name: Kantrael Pattern M36 Lasgun
item_lasgun_kantrael.description: The reliable, mass-produced backbone rifle of the Astra Militarum. Emits high-energy coherent light pulses.

item_power_fist.name: Astartes Mark IV Power Fist
item_power_fist.description: Oversized armored gauntlet surrounded by matter-disrupting energy crackle. Crushes vehicles into scrap metal.

item_carapace_armor.name: Enforcer Hardened Carapace Armor
item_carapace_armor.description: Interlocking molded plasteel and ceramite plates over ballistic mesh weave.

item_power_armor_mk10.name: Astartes Mark X Tacticus Power Armor
item_power_armor_mk10.description: Sealed ceramite power suit with neural interface bundle and synthetic muscle-fiber bundles.

item_tech_robes_lead.name: Lead-Lined Crimson Tech-Robes
item_tech_robes_lead.description: Heavy sacred Martian robes insulated against radiation, acid vapors, and electric discharges.

item_flak_armor.name: Imperial Guard Flak Vest & Helmet
item_flak_armor.description: Layered ablative thermoplas and carbon-fiber plates designed to dissipate shrapnel.

item_bionic_locomotion.name: Hydraulic Bionic Leg Augmetic
item_bionic_locomotion.description: Industrial hydraulic piston legs replacing damaged organic limbs, granting rapid sprint burst.

item_cortex_implant.name: Logic Cortex Cogitator Implant
item_cortex_implant.description: Sub-cranial logic unit connected directly to the central nervous system.

item_aquila_rosary.name: Bone-Carved Imperial Aquila Rosary
item_aquila_rosary.description: Consecrated with the ashes of martyrs; anchors the soul against despair and warp temptation.

item_purity_seal_sanctus.name: Purity Seal of Saint Katherine
item_purity_seal_sanctus.description: Parchment inscribed with sacred battle-oaths affixed with red stamping wax.

item_null_collar.name: Blackstone Null Dampening Collar
item_null_collar.description: Ancient xenos-derived blackstone array that completely suppresses psychic energy.

item_relic_blade_macragge.name: Gladius of Macragge (Master-Crafted Relic Blade)
item_relic_blade_macragge.description: An ancient power sword forged in the armouries of Ultramar, imbued with an energetic disruption field that cleaves through starship bulkheads.

item_indomitus_terminator_armor.name: Indomitus Pattern Tactical Dreadnought Armor
item_indomitus_terminator_armor.description: Walking tank plate of bonded ceramite-plasteel reinforced with an integrated Crux Terminatus displacement forcefield.

item_storm_bolter.name: Astartes Twin-Linked Storm Bolter
item_storm_bolter.description: Twin-barrel mass-reactive bolt weapon firing .75 caliber explosive penetrators at extreme cyclic rates.

item_void_relic_blade.name: Eclipser: Sunder-Soul Relic Blade
item_void_relic_blade.description: A dark obsidian disruption blade fused with the warp-fire of Lord Malgakor; tears both physical ceramite and ethereal souls.

item_void_power_plate.name: Corrupted Aegis of the Void Marine
item_void_power_plate.description: Midnight-blue and void-blackened power plate infused with warp-essence and Necrodermis chronomancy.

item_sanctified_thunder_hammer.name: Hammer of Macragge (Sanctified Master-Crafted Thunder Hammer)
item_sanctified_thunder_hammer.description: A devastating Astartes warhammer inscribed with the Litany of Hatred; releases omni-directional kinetic shockwaves upon impact.

item_cyclone_missile_pack.name: Shoulder-Mounted Cyclone Missile Launcher
item_cyclone_missile_pack.description: Twin-pod automated anti-titan missile launcher mounted over Terminator pauldrons.
